source_title: Politics News: INDIA Bloc's 'Jan Mahabhiyog' Programme Postponed Due to Rain, Rahul Gandhi to Address Press Conference!
source_excerpt:
The INDIA bloc's 'Jan Mahabhiyog' programme, which was scheduled to take place today at Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge's residence in Delhi, has been postponed due to continuous rainfall. According to sources, the opposition leaders are now preparing to organise the programme tomorrow in the same format as originally planned. The event was intended to bring together leaders from several opposition parties to initiate a proposed impeachment motion against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Preparations for the programme had reportedly been completed, with a stage set up and chairs arranged for leaders from different political parties. However, unfavourable weather conditions disrupted the arrangements, forcing the opposition to postpone the event. Meanwhile, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge and other INDIA bloc leaders are expected to address a press conference shortly to explain the decision and share details about their next course of action. According to the latest information, several INDIA bloc floor leaders have already reached Mallikarjun Kharge's residence in Delhi. Leaders from various opposition parties are expected to participate in the meeting and press conference. JMM Rajya Sabha MP Mahua Maji was also seen arriving at the Congress President's residence ahead of the proposed meeting. The opposition leaders are expected to discuss the revised schedule and the future course of their planned political action against Gyanesh Kumar. Although the preparations were reportedly complete, the continuous rainfall affected the outdoor arrangements and disrupted the day's programme. The postponement has added a fresh development to the opposition's political campaign against the Chief Election Commissioner. The INDIA bloc is now expected to proceed with its planned initiative tomorrow, subject to the revised arrangements and weather conditions.
